description: Read-only export of which Shopify variant each Spark item is linked to: item id, SKU and name, store, Shopify variant gid, Shopify inventory item id (the level Spark writes stock to), the variant's Shopify name, and linkedVariantCount — how many variants at that store share the item. Use it to audit links before switching a Shopify location to push. Pass multipleVariantsOnly=true to list only items linked to more than one variant (a SKU duplicated in Shopify): Spark pushes such an item's stock only to its single active listing, and pushes nothing while two listings are active. A null shopifyInventoryItemId means the link predates inventory ids and needs a product sync before it can receive pushes. Location-to-warehouse mappings and their sync modes come from get_shopify_store_settings. Pages hold at most 100 rows; continue with offset = offset + limit while hasMore is true. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token.

multipleVariantsOnly.description: Only items linked to more than one Shopify variant at a store (duplicated SKUs).

offset.description: Zero-based row offset; requires limit when nonzero.

shopifyStoreUrl.description: Optional store domain to read, matched case-insensitively.
